questions.prompt: Is a hot dog a sandwich? Answer in under 60 words.
questions.answer: Technically, maybe. A sandwich is usually filling between bread, and a hot dog fits that loosely. But most people, and the National Hot Dog and Sausage Council, treat it as its own thing. So: **by definition, arguable; by culture, no.**

questions.prompt: Give me one tip to stop procrastinating.
questions.answer:
Here's one that works surprisingly well:

**The 2 minute start.** Tell yourself you'll work on the task for just two minutes.

- Starting is the hardest part
- Momentum usually carries you past the two minutes
- Even if it doesn't, you've made progress

Want a few more strategies tailored to your situation? 😊

questions.prompt: Roast my plan to wake up at 5am every day.
questions.answer: Ah yes, the 5am club. You'll join on Monday, hit snooze on Tuesday, and by Thursday you'll be telling people you're "more of a night person anyway." Bold plan though. Respect.

questions.prompt: Explain why the sky is blue in two sentences.
questions.answer: Sunlight scatters off molecules in the air, and shorter blue wavelengths scatter much more than red ones, a process called Rayleigh scattering. That scattered blue light reaches your eyes from every direction, so the whole sky looks blue.
